correctness.rationale: Excitation sector k has target-ground occupied dimension binom(n,k) at equal eigenvalue q^k/(1+q)^n and target-excited dimension binom(n,k−1). Ky Fan bound min(a,b) attained simultaneously by sector basis permutations. Pascal binomial symmetry yields F_{2m}=F_{2m−1} and pair gain Catalan_m q^(m+1)/(1+q)^(2m+1). Catalan generating function gives F_odd↑q strictly for finite positive q, yielding q>1/2 threshold; Stirling C_m~4^m/(sqrt(pi)m^(3/2)) and uniform r near 8/9 yield loglog correction and O(1) error. q=0 and q=1 limits and monotone q crossing considered.
